lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eAjusta los órdenes de:
"

Adjust the bond orders and press Check: the checker reviews the bond pattern of the contributor.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eAl formar \u003cb\u00:
"

When forming Fe³⁺ the 4s electrons are removed first and then the 3d; that is why the ion ends up 3d⁵ (half-filled).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eAufbau (menor energía:
"

Aufbau (lowest energy first), the Pauli exclusion principle and Hund's rule (one electron in each orbital before pairing).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eCada paso agrega elec:
"

Each step adds electrons following the Aufbau order. Watch which rule is applied (Aufbau, Pauli or Hund) in each subshell.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eCada punto es una pos:
"

Each dot is a possible electron position sampled from |ψ|². In the 1s the cloud is spherical and the densest zone is near the nucleus; the radial graph shows the most probable radius (a₀).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eCambia los átomos enl:
"

Change the bonded atoms and the lone pairs: geometries, angles and hybridization are updated.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eCasi todas las partíc:
"

Almost all α particles pass through the foil, but a few bounce straight back: the positive charge is concentrated in a tiny nucleus.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eCO₂ tiene enlaces pol:
"

CO₂ has polar bonds but opposite dipoles that cancel: it is nonpolar. Change molecule to compare.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eCompara los modelos l:
"

Compare the models side by side: what object changes (nucleus, electron) and what idea is preserved (matter is discrete).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eComparación de las ge:
"

Comparison of the geometries by number of domains and lone pairs.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eCuatro dominios elect:
"

Four electron domains (tetrahedral) but only two bonded atoms: the shape is bent and the lone pairs compress the H–O–H angle.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eCuatro enlaces idénti:
"

Four identical bonds, no lone pair: 109.5° angles and dipoles that cancel, a nonpolar molecule.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eCuenta electrones, el:
"

Count electrons, choose the central atom and complete octets. Advance with Next. The O ends up with two lone pairs.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eDecide qué elemento t:
"

Decide which element has the higher value of the indicated property and check whether your reasoning matches the trend.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eDos elementos del mis:
"

Two elements of the same period: chlorine has a much higher electronegativity and electron affinity. Change the property to contrast them.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl \u003cb\u003e2p\u0:
"

The 2p has two lobes of opposite sign (red and blue) separated by a nodal plane through the nucleus. The sign is the phase of ψ, not a charge.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl \u003cb\u003e3s\u0:
"

The 3s has n − ℓ − 1 = 2 radial nodes (spheres where |ψ|² = 0) and three zones of high probability; look at the peaks in the radial graph.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl \u003cb\u003ecromo:
"

Chromium (Z = 24) adopts 3d⁵4s¹ and not 3d⁴4s²: the half-filled d subshell is energetically favorable.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl color indica el va:
"

The color indicates the value of the property. Electronegativity increases upward and to the right: click an element to see its data and the trend arrows.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl doble enlace añade:
"

The double bond adds a π bond through side-by-side overlap of p orbitals: rotation would break that overlap, which is why cis/trans isomers exist.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl enlace simple es u:
"

The single bond is a single σ bond (sp³): it allows free rotation about the axis.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl radio disminuye a:
"

The radius decreases across the period (more nuclear charge, same level) and increases down the group (more levels).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl símbolo de Lewis r:
"

The Lewis symbol represents the valence electrons: first one electron on each side and then they pair up.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl triple enlace tien:
"

The triple bond has one σ and two perpendicular π bonds (sp): the molecule is linear.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl último hito de la:
"

The last milestone on the timeline is the quantum model, in which electrons are described by probability clouds instead of orbits.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eElige tus respuestas:
"

Choose your answers and press Review. Predicting before seeing the result is the best way to detect prior ideas.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn el \u003cb\u003ehi:
"

In iron (Z = 26) the 4s fills before the 3d. Notice how many electrons remain unpaired: they explain its magnetic behavior.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn el \u003cb\u003eoz:
"

In ozone there are two equivalent contributors. The real molecule does not alternate between them: it is a hybrid with bonds of equal length.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn el benceno los sei:
"

In benzene the six π electrons are spread over the whole ring, above and below the plane.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn el octaedro los pa:
"

In the octahedron the lone pairs sit in opposite positions: XeF₄ is square planar and nonpolar.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn la bipirámide trig:
"

In the trigonal bipyramid there are distinct axial and equatorial positions. Lone pairs prefer the equatorial ones (SF₄, seesaw shape).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa \u003cb\u003ecarga:
"

The formal charge measures how far each atom is from its valence count. In CO₂ with double bonds all are zero: it is the best structure.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa carga de las gotas:
"

The charge of the drops is always an integer multiple of e. Move the experimental control and watch how the falling speed changes.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa diferencia de elec:
"

The electronegativity difference makes the bond polar. It is shown here in water; compare with CO₂, where the dipoles cancel by geometry.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa línea de tiempo re:
"

The timeline runs through the atomic models. Each one is presented with the evidence that motivated it, what it explained and what it left open.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLas líneas del espect:
"

The lines of the spectrum are explained by jumps between energy levels: each line corresponds to a fixed energy difference.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLos electrones muestr:
"

Electrons show diffraction: they behave like waves, which opens the door to the quantum model (de Broglie).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLos orbitales \u003cb:
"

The d orbitals have ℓ = 2: two angular nodes. The 3dxy has four lobes with alternating signs between the xz and yz nodal planes.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLos picos corresponde:
"

The peaks correspond to the noble gases and the minima to the alkali metals: the property repeats with the period.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eNúmero de enlaces σ y:
"

Number of σ and π bonds, hybridization, geometry and possibility of rotation for each bond type.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003ePara el \u003cb\u003e:
"

For carbon (Z = 6) you have the full notation, the condensed one and the orbital diagram: three ways of saying the same thing. Notice the two unpaired electrons (Hund's rule).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003ePredice la geometría:
"

Predict the geometry before reviewing: count domains, subtract lone pairs and decide the shape.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003ePulsa \u003cb\u003eRo:
"

Press Rotate: as the bond twists, the π overlap decreases and the energy rises to a maximum at 90°.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eRadicales (NO₂), octe:
"

Radicals (NO₂), incomplete octets (BF₃) and hypervalent species (PCl₅) do not obey the simple octet rule.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eResponde preguntas al:
"

Answer random questions about notation, unpaired electrons and blocks.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eResponde y pulsa \u00:
"

Answer and press Review. Think about formal charges before choosing the most stable structure.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eSe necesita más energ:
"

More energy is needed to remove an electron as you move across the period, because the effective nuclear charge increases.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eTodas las tendencias:
"

All the trends arise from the competition between effective nuclear charge, shielding and electron distance.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eUn campo eléctrico o:
"

An electric or magnetic field deflects the beam: the particles have negative charge and the same charge-to-mass ratio whatever the gas.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eσ: solapamiento front:
"

σ: head-on overlap, cylindrical symmetry. π: side-by-side overlap, with a nodal plane containing the axis.

"
lit.\u0027Arrastra la molécula para rotarla: "Drag the molecule to rotate it in 3D. Turn lone pairs and dipoles on or off. Export the image with the capture button."
lit.\u0027cada hito con evidencia, explicaci: "each milestone with evidence, explanation and limits."
lit.\u0027cinco experimentos con control des: "five experiments with a slider and a Run button."
lit.\u0027El cromo no sigue el esquema simpl: "Chromium does not follow the simple scheme"
lit.\u0027Elige el tipo de enlace, activa lo: "Choose the bond type, turn on the orbitals and press Rotate to see the torsional energy."
lit.\u0027elige elemento y carga para ver qu: "choose an element and load it to see which electrons leave first."
lit.\u0027Elige moléculas, avanza por la con: "Choose molecules, step through the construction and turn on the formal charge and polarity layers. Practice in “Build” and “Challenges”."
lit.\u0027Elige un elemento por lista, búsqu: "Choose an element from the list, search or mini table; review the step-by-step filling, the ions and the rules."
lit.\u0027Elige una propiedad, filtra por bl: "Choose a property, filter by block or search for an element. Compare two elements and graph the property between two atomic numbers."
lit.\u0027oculta la respuesta para que predi: "hides the answer so you can predict."
lit.\u0027Qué cambia y qué permanece\u0027: "What changes and what stays the same"
lit.\u0027Recorre la línea de tiempo, ejecut: "Go through the timeline, run the five historical experiments with their control, compare the models and solve the challenge."
